DRESS CODE

A Candlelit Affair

In keeping with the atmosphere of our candlelit celebration, we invite you to dress in garden-formal attire — elegant, romantic, and timeless.

Ladies

Elegant midi or floor-length dresses in the soft, romantic shades of our wedding palette. Think flowing silhouettes and refined fabrics.

Good to Know

A few things
before the day.

What time should I arrive?

Please arrive by 4:00 PM. The ceremony begins at 4:30 PM.

Can I bring my children?

We adore your little ones, but we’re keeping our celebration an intimate, adults-only evening.

Can I bring a guest?

We’re only able to accommodate the guests named on each invitation.

What should I wear?

We invite our ladies to wear garden-formal midi or floor-length dresses in our suggested pastel palette, and our gentlemen to wear traditional Barong Tagalog with formal trousers and dress shoes. You can see the colors in the Dress Code section above.
